roomTable.currentlyCorrect: 14 base-capacity rows; sunlight adjustment and people/kitchen increments agree with ENERGY STAR.
roomTable.addToUI: Table assumes an 8-foot ceiling. Heights above it may need more capacity; no numeric height multiplier is supplied.
roomTable.boundaryIssue: Source adjoining rows say 100 up to 150, 150 up to 250, etc. No explicit half-open convention. Current upper-inclusive choice should be stated; do not silently claim source settles shared endpoints.

readyHeatMode.formula: Q_J=m_kg*c_J/(kg*K)*deltaT_K; volume alternative m=rho*L*W*H. deltaF*5/9=deltaK. Q_BTU_IT=Q_J/1055.05585262.
inputs: positive mass OR positive volume and user-entered density
signed temperature change in C/K or F
outputs: direction: heat added / removed / no temperature change
limits: Constant heat capacity; no phase change, moisture/latent heat, ventilation, solar gain or building losses.
Q is energy, not an air-conditioner capacity. BTU/h requires a defined duration/power model; never relabel BTU as BTU/h.
The volume fixture uses entered air properties as an explicit assumption, not a verified universal air default.

optionalConductionWorksheet.formula: steadyHeatRate_W=sum(U_W/(m2*K)*area_m2)*deltaK; U=k/thickness or 1/R_total if valid entered assembly values.
optionalConductionWorksheet.scope: Only entered steady conduction; not a cooling design load or Manual J. Excludes solar, humidity, ducts, ventilation and time-varying storage.

unresolvedCompetitorFactors: No verified primary coefficients for generic insulation/climate/room-type multiplier controls. Do not invent coefficients or infer competitor hidden formulas. A transparent user-entered heat-loss coefficient / design temperature alternative is local, but does not close full sizing parity.
rights: Formula facts and original explanations can be implemented without reproducing manual charts; source availability is not a claim of ACCA approval or legal clearance.
